design_philosophy: Ultra-minimalist, distraction-free editorial workspace. Uses absolute monochrome with stark high-contrast elements to enforce focus. No generic SaaS blue or purple. Content is king; the UI fades away.

layout.container: max-w-[900px] mx-auto w-full px-6 py-12 md:py-24
layout.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for internal card padding. gap-8 between major vertical sections.
layout.alignment: Strictly left-aligned internal content to maintain reading flow. Container is centered.
layout.background_strategy: Fixed textured background image with low opacity to prevent pure flat black deadness.

tabs.customization: Remove default gray background. Use a transparent list with a bottom border (border-b border-zinc-800). Active tab gets a stark white bottom border (border-white) and white text. Inactive tabs are zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-300.

textarea.customization: Massive, breathable text area. h-[40vh] minimum. bg-transparent, border-zinc-800, focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-white. No heavy shadows. text-lg for comfortable writing.

input.customization: Used for Context/Tone. bg-transparent border-zinc-800 focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-white h-12.

button.customization: Primary CTA (Generate) must be bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-none or ultra-subtle rounded-md. Secondary buttons (Copy) are ghost or outline with border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300.

card.customization: Used for Output Display. bg-zinc-900/30 border border-zinc-800 backdrop-blur-sm. MUST have p-8 to give the generated text room to breathe.

icons.instructions: Use minimalist icons. 1.25 stroke width for a lighter, more refined look.

images.description: Dark ambient texture. Use as a fixed background (e.g., fixed inset-0 object-cover opacity-20 pointer-events-none -z-10) to add subtle grain and depth to the dark theme.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactables must have a clear hover state. Text colors shift from zinc-500 to zinc-300 to white.
interactions_and_motion.focus: Use ring-1 ring-white ring-offset-0 ring-offset-transparent for maximum crispness.

testing.attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (tabs, textarea, context input, generate button, output container, and copy button).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React application using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI components.
Implement the 4 modes (Grammar, Email, Tone, Rewrite) using Shadcn Tabs at the top.
Do NOT build a sidebar. The entire application must sit within a max-w-[900px] horizontally centered container.
Include a large, spacious textarea for the main text input, and a smaller input field directly below it for optional context or tone instructions.
The output area should be displayed seamlessly below the input area after text generation, inside a styled Card component, featuring a prominent 'Copy' button (use lucide-react 'Copy' icon).
Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Copied to clipboard').
Ensure the background image is applied globally with low opacity to give texture to the pure dark theme.
Import and apply Cabinet Grotesk for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body text, and JetBrains Mono for small labels or code snippets.
Make sure all components implement the 'data-testid' attribute as specified for testing.
Integrate the frontend with the FastAPI backend endpoint for Claude Sonnet 4.5 text generation.
